title: Beautiful Hilltop Retreat (3/2). 5 miles from DT
description:
This beautiful 3/2 home sits on a hilltop with East Nashville vistas and is a quick drive to food spots, shops and DT. Relax in a Japanese soaking tub, share cocktails under a historic 200 yr old oak tree shading the back patio or sit on the deck and watch deer & turkey stroll through the yard. Whether you are in town for work or play this home has it all for a comfort and accessibility.
Owners prefer guests with at least one positive and no negative reviews. 
We look forward to hosting you!
